song_craft: Reductio pressed to the turn (9v): unperceived-purpose → unspeakable-merely → generic-will? → omniscience-explodes → One-keeps-apart → natures kit → courtesy-purpose → grant-hangs → churn-never-ceases. Cross-verse sentences kept running (vv37–38, vv44–45).

lines: If mind's arising stands unmarked by any spirit's eye,
then 'for the spirit's sake' rings hollow — no purpose holds.

verses.craft: Cross-verse sentence opened (completes v38 per UNC); rings-hollow close.
verses.rejected: (a) closing here → killed: sentence runs on.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Cross-verse sentence: bare puruṣārthatā completes in v38's avācyā — read together."]) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Of spirit, of nature — unspeakable, the mere word stays;
yet mind's own motions come conditioned, each in private ways.

verses.craft: Unspeakable-merely; private-ways close; concession is objectors best (UNC).
verses.rejected: (a) pressing early → killed: press lands v39.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["cd concedes the objector's best case (individual conditioning) to press it in v39."]) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Will — how could it serve the purposes of every soul?
Give it to nature-in-general, for all, to make it whole?

verses.craft: How-question marks generic escape; whole-making questioned.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ['kiṃ-tu pivots to the generic-pradhāna escape, demolished in v40.']) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Unfelt by spirit, whose is will — and felt, then known by whom?
By all — then every soul is all-knowing: see where that must go.

verses.craft: Reductio: all-knowing-every-soul; see-where close points onward.
verses.rejected: (a) blunting reductio → killed: explosion is the proof.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: One light would mix all separate shinings into one,
unless some One, in all undivided, keeps each apart — the turn begun.

verses.craft: Īśvara-turn begun; unless-One-keeps-apart hinge; siddhāntin-voiced per UNC.
verses.rejected: (a) objector voice → killed: turn is ours.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["cd — the objector's escape that becomes the Īśvara-turn; voice held as siddhāntin-voiced."]) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: No world-plan makes the seed put forth the sprout;
blind nature — kit and cause — brings green about.

verses.craft: Natures kit stated fairly; green-brought-about kept vivid.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: What comes, well-formed — the wise join part to part;
we call it spirit's purpose — but by courtesy's art.

verses.craft: Courtesys-art close; purpose-as-metaphor (upacāra thread for v44).
verses.rejected: (a) denying courtesy → killed: concession threads on.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ['upacāra-concession: puruṣārthatva merely metaphorical — the thread pulled in v44.']) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Say granted — still, when purpose ends, before the freed soul's face,
what stops the churn? The question hangs, demanding place.
l4.sanskrit_cite: iti cet tatsamāptau api puruṣārthe api taṃ prati

verses.craft: Grant suspends; question-hangs demanding-place (apodosis in v45 per UNC).
verses.rejected: (a) landing blow here → killed: blow lands v45.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ['Protasis suspends; apodosis lands in v45.']) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: The Root would churn its own effects and never cease;
oh, never — sevenfold nature grants no release!
l4.sanskrit_cite: na viramen mūlakāraṇam āho na viramati

verses.craft: Churn-never-ceases; sevenfold-no-release; ironic āho per UNC (objectors triumph voiced to collapse).
verses.rejected: (a) unironic triumph → killed: irony drives to v52.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["āho ironic — the objector's triumph voiced to collapse it; drives to v52's buddhimatkartṛ."]) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice
